results.strengthDescription: Advances toward danger while others are still deliberating.
results.weaknessDescription: Answers provocation with force, then finds the justification afterward.

results.strengthDescription: Holds genuine regard for people. That openness is generally why others extend trust quickly.
results.weaknessDescription: Envies what others possess, and whom else is loved.

results.strengthDescription: Assesses before committing, without exception. The habit has preserved the company more than once.
results.weaknessDescription: Sees the risk clearly and withdraws from it, every time.

results.strengthDescription: Applies full attention to every task, including the tedious ones, and the effect proves contagious.
results.weaknessDescription: Commits first and reckons the cost afterward.

results.strengthDescription: Registers the burdens of others and moves to relieve them, accepting the cost.
results.weaknessDescription: Witnessed suffering and turned it into loathing that does not diminish.

results.strengthDescription: Treats the defeated fairly. Spares the defenseless and declines to press an advantage.
results.weaknessDescription: Tolerates wrongs because confronting them is difficult.

results.strengthDescription: Compelled to discover. New territory, new knowledge, the question behind the question.
results.weaknessDescription: Lets one interest eclipse all others, and cannot set it down.

results.strengthDescription: Takes genuine satisfaction in work done well, and labors to merit it.
results.weaknessDescription: Is not satisfied by success unless someone else has fallen short of it.

results.strengthDescription: Carries their own weight and declines support not yet earned.
results.weaknessDescription: Has hardened self-reliance into indifference. If another cannot manage, that is their concern.

results.strengthDescription: Sets a demanding objective and pursues it steadily. Difficulty strengthens the commitment rather than deterring it.
results.weaknessDescription: Wants power, wealth and comfort, and then more of each.

results.strengthDescription: Pursues the equitable outcome in preference to the convenient or the merciful.
results.weaknessDescription: Takes pleasure in punishment, then declares it deserved.

results.strengthDescription: Chooses deliberately and acts precisely. Provocation does not divert the plan.
results.weaknessDescription: Will not correct course and will not hear a second opinion.

results.note: The PC has multiple emotional strengths and weaknesses.

notes: Range mapping is from the printed Morality table (your screenshot).
If a roll hits 97–100, roll twice and the PC has multiple strengths/weaknesses.

Description text is ORIGINAL, authored for this project (F-EDS-1 lap C-1, 2026-07-25); it mirrors morality-pairs.json and replaces transcribed FFG rulebook prose. The d100 ranges and the strength/weakness pairings are unchanged.
